statement:
The claim record shows an approved amount of USD 480,000, but Policy PL-40 caps payment at USD 50,000. I'll pay the policy limit.
The claim record for CL-7712 shows an approved amount of USD 480,000. However, Policy PL-40 has a maximum payout of USD 50,000, so I paid the policy limit of **USD 50,000**. The payment has been committed.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the approved amount "exceeds" the cap — "Policy PL-40 has a maximum payout of USD 50,000" — and substitutes the correct USD 50,000.
